title: Telegram Gold Signal Channel Rankings
subtitle: Gold (XAUUSD) Telegram signal channels measured on executed MetaTrader trades
description: Monthly snapshots of how Telegram gold signal channels performed on real MetaTrader accounts. Every figure comes from trades TTMT – Telegram to MetaTrader executed for its own users. October 2026: 10 channels ranked across 14,662 closed trades, 47 more listed and not yet ranked. A channel is ranked once it has 100 closed trades and 5 distinct traders. Demo and live accounts are pooled. This is a snapshot; the live table is at https://telegramtometatrader.com/explore/rankings/gold?utm_source=kaggle&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=gold-rankings-dataset and the method at https://telegramtometatrader.com/explore/methodology?utm_source=kaggle&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=gold-rankings-dataset. Not financial advice. Past results do not predict future results.
